defects: Mohammed is not seated on tread 3 with his feet on tread 2: his pelvis hovers in front of riser 3 at the level of tread 2's nosing while his legs extend nearly straight down across riser 2 with his feet resting down on tread 1, making him look semi-standing against the steps.
Because his knees are barely bent (~140°), his hands rest flat against the front of his thighs with fingers clipping slightly into the white djellaba cloth instead of resting on bent knees.
A hard-edged dark triangular cast shadow is projected across three steps to screen-left, mismatching the soft diffused lighting of the painted staircase plate.
tiles.fix: Translate Mohammed's pelvis back and up so his buttocks rest solidly on the horizontal surface of tread 3, bend his knees to ~90° so his feet plant flat on tread 2, and soften the projected stair shadow.

defects: Pose is completely static and identical to s09 0.3: Mohammed's pelvis still hovers in front of riser 3 while his feet reach down to tread 1 across two steps instead of settling onto tread 3 with feet on tread 2.
Fingers clip slightly into the front of the djellaba skirt over his straight thighs.
tiles.fix: Seat Mohammed's pelvis fully onto tread 3 with knees bent and feet planted on tread 2, adding a slight settling compression in the torso and shoulders.

defects: Despite the line 'Accroupi sur une marche, les mains sur les genoux, je réfléchis profondément', Mohammed is in an upright semi-standing slouch spanning from tread 2/riser 3 (pelvis) down to tread 1 (feet) with barely bent knees.
His head and gaze remain level toward screen-right rather than bowed in deep thought, and his fingertips clip into the white robe on his thighs.
tiles.fix: Put Mohammed into a true compact seated/crouched pose on tread 3 with feet on tread 2, hands resting cleanly on bent knees, and bow his head slightly in thought.

defects: Bad bottom framing: the tighter crop cuts right through Mohammed's ankles and slices off his feet at the bottom edge of the frame.
His pelvis still hovers in front of riser 3 with nearly straight legs spanning down toward tread 1 instead of sitting on tread 3 with feet on tread 2.
tiles.fix: Once Mohammed is properly seated on tread 3 with feet on tread 2, tilt or widen the crop slightly so his full feet and tread 2 contact remain visible inside the frame.

defects: While the chin-up head tilt reads for 'Elle méritait le silence', his body remains in the same semi-standing hover across two risers (pelvis at tread 2 nosing, feet down on tread 1).
The bottom frame edge cuts through his ankles/feet.
tiles.fix: Keep the proud chin-up head angle but seat his pelvis on tread 3 with bent knees and feet visible on tread 2 within the frame.

defects: The enumeration box is placed directly over the left pottery planter, obscuring the painted geranium blossoms it names, and the lower listed words ('œillets', 'roses') are dark brown on a dark brown box, making them nearly illegible.
tiles.fix: Move the enumeration box into the upper-left wall/sky area above the flower pot and brighten the text for 'œillets' and 'roses' as each word is spoken.

defects: Mohammed's head lowers slightly for b050, but his shoulders remain stiff and his pelvis still hovers in front of riser 3 with legs stretched down to tread 1.
His feet are cropped off by the bottom edge of the frame.
tiles.fix: Seat Mohammed on tread 3 with feet on tread 2 inside the frame and drop his shoulders and chest into a clear deflated slump.

defects: Duplicate subtitle line with s09 71.0, and Mohammed snaps back to his neutral upright head pose instead of holding the deflated shoulder-drop beat.
Pelvis still hovers at tread 2 nosing with legs extending to tread 1 and feet cut off at the bottom frame edge.
tiles.fix: Hold the slumped shoulders and lowered head through the end of the line while seated properly on tread 3 with feet visible on tread 2.

defects: Mohammed remains in the stiff semi-standing hover spanning riser 2 and riser 3 with his feet sliced off at the bottom edge of the frame.
tiles.fix: Seat Mohammed on tread 3 with bent knees and feet on tread 2 fully visible inside the crop.

defects: Missing key acting beat (b051 'fists tighten on his knees'): Mohammed's hands remain flat and open against his thighs with extended fingers, identical to the previous tiles.
Pelvis still hovers in front of riser 3 with legs reaching down to tread 1 and feet cropped at the bottom frame edge.
tiles.fix: Clench both of Mohammed's hands into tight fists pressing into his bent knees and tense his shoulders forward while seated on tread 3.

defects: Missing enumeration device/insert for 'pieds' (b052): the shot stays on the static stair view of Mohammed with no on-screen enumeration box or insert.
Mohammed is still hovering across two steps with his feet cut off at the bottom frame edge—ironically hiding his feet on the line 'si je me lavais les pieds'.
tiles.fix: Either cut to the 'pieds' insert with the enumeration box highlighting 'pieds', or show the enumeration box and ensure Mohammed's bare feet are fully visible on tread 2.

defects: In theenumeration box, 'pieds' is highlighted in bright cream while 'prière' (the active word for this beat) is left dim dark brown and barely legible.
Anatomical defect in the painted plate: the father's right-most/center hand resting on the prayer rug has six digits (five long fingers plus a thumb on the left side).
tiles.fix: Highlight 'prière' in bright cream inside the enumeration box and paint out the extra sixth finger on the father's center hand.

defects: Wrong gaze direction for b053 ('eyes up the flight'): Mohammed is still looking down and screen-right (down the staircase) instead of looking up the flight (screen-left/up).
Despite 'accroupi sur ma marche', he remains in the semi-standing hover with pelvis at tread 2 nosing and feet cut off at the bottom edge of the frame.
tiles.fix: Seat Mohammed compactly on tread 3 with feet on tread 2 and turn his head and eyes screen-left/upward toward the top of the stairs.

defects: Wrong gaze and facial acting for b053 ('he repeats his sentence to himself, eyes up the flight, lips moving'): Mohammed looks down the stairs (screen-right) with his mouth firmly closed.
Pelvis still hovers in front of riser 3 with feet extending to tread 1 and cropped at the bottom of the frame.
tiles.fix: Direct Mohammed's head and eye-line up the flight (screen-left/up), open his lips slightly to read as speaking to himself, and seat him properly on tread 3 with feet on tread 2.

worst_problem: Throughout all 3D stair shots, Mohammed is not seated on tread 3 with his feet on tread 2 (his pelvis hovers in front of riser 3 while his nearly straight legs reach down to tread 1 with feet cropped off in the closer shots), and key acting beats—clenched fists on 'à mort' (s09 80.7) and looking up the flight while speaking (s09 96.6–101.4)—are missing.
